name: icat_extract
description: Extract a file from a disk image by inode to a path under the run. Refuses an inode the catalogue lists only as a directory (icat would give its index). Returns JSON with path, size, sha256, image, offset and the file's catalogued path.

inode.description: Sleuth Kit inode/address to extract, for example 168 or 168-128-4 for an NTFS stream

image.description: Image path. Defaults to the single disk image under inputs/: one with a disk image's extension, or one the catalogue read as a disk (catalog/<input>/partitions.txt).

offset.description: Volume offset in sectors for icat -o. Defaults to the one filesystem the catalogue lists for the image (catalog/<input>/p<start>/); several mean pass it; none is 0.
